messages:
raj (sales): Heads up — ACME is asking for a contractual commitment: 99.99% uptime + 50ms p95 for text-gen endpoints (payments product). They want this in the MSA. Can product confirm feasibility and options?

bella (cs): Context: they're currently on hosted, ~120 qps peak, avg seq length ~80 tokens. Strategic customer, willing to sign a 2yr Dedicated contract if we can hit latency + SLA.

anna (pm): Thanks. Two immediate asks: 1) realistic engineering scope to promise 99.99% + 50ms p95; 2) what tradeoffs/pricing would be needed.

marcus (sre): Quick take: 99.99% across single region requires multi-az + active failover + SLA-backed Dedicated capacity. 50ms p95 is ambitious — depends heavily on model size & seq length. For 80 tokens, 50ms p95 => likely need smaller model (<=7B) with optimized kernels or specialized hardware. Also inbound network latency to their region matters.

olivia (eng-runtime): Agree with marcus. Options:
- Option A: Dedicated hot pool in customer region running quantized 7B with kernel optimizations. Estimated infra delta: +40-60% cost vs current hosted.
- Option B: Multi-region Dedicated with warm standby + automated failover for 99.99%. Adds complexity but feasible.
- Option C: If ACME accepts higher p95 (e.g., 100-150ms) we can use 13B quantized with lower infra uplift.

anna (pm): Can we get a short implementation plan + rough ETA for Option A/B? Sales needs a proposal by EOW.

marcus (sre): Plan sketch for Option A: 1) capacity reservation + autoscale tailoring (2 weeks ops), 2) runtime perf tuning + kernel selection (2-3 weeks), 3) canary + SLA verif (1 week). Total ~5-6 weeks, assuming no major infra blockers. Will need dedicated NOC rotation on rollout.

olivia (eng-runtime): Perf tasks: quantize and tune model, enable continuous batching control, hot key cache for short prefixes. I can scope a PoC this week.

raj (sales): Budget note: ACME expects pricing anchored to availability SLA and latency guarantees. They're open to a markup for Dedicated + premium support.

anna (pm): Routing + triage: I created intake ticket with minimal fields. triage-bot, can you create backlog item with tags `contract-sla`, `dedicated`, `latency-critical` and link to sales brief?

triage-bot: Created PROD-8421 in product backlog: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-8421 (tags: contract-sla, dedicated, latency-critical). Assigned to anna (pm).

anna (pm): Owners & next steps: - anna: consolidate proposal for sales (due EOW) - olivia + marcus: PoC scope and risk notes (by Tue) - bella + raj: negotiate contract levers (support tier, penalty caps) - eng-oncall: standby plan for rollout

marcus (sre): Also recommend adding SLA escalation path in contract: primary notify to SRE + 1hr on-call response for P0, and engineering hotfix SLA for latency regressions.

bella (cs): I'll surface these options in the customer conversation tomorrow and push for willingness to trade latency vs cost.

anna (pm): Good. I'll file detailed acceptance criteria: uptime measurement method, covered regions, penalty calculation, and test harness for latency verification. Will share draft in thread. :white_check_mark:
